$comment: PROPOSED temporary build-tool advisory exceptions (ADR-005). Inactive: approval.status must be 'approved' with approvedBy and approvedAt set in a reviewed commit, AND the gate must be wired into CI, before any record exempts anything. Every record expires 2026-11-12T00:00:00Z.

records.reason: Dev-only lint dependency. fast-glob runs only when settings.next.rootDir is set (it is not; enforced by web-lint-root-dir). Not in the production build.
Metro build tooling. Glob patterns come only from Metro's own config; worst case is a crash of a local or CI build. Not in app bundles (enforced by bundle-sources).

Expo CLI tooling. PKCS#1 v1.5 verify only checks signatures the CLI just produced, or developer-owned certs when expo-updates code signing is configured (it is not; enforced by mobile-update-signing). Not in app bundles.
